svg.title: Observed advertised prices for identifiable broker records
svg.desc: Duke University researchers reported identifiable military-related records advertised for 12 to 32 US cents per record in November 2023. The 100-record and 10,000-record bars are arithmetic illustrations using the same unit range. Units are nominal US dollars. Source: Duke University Sanford School of Public Policy, Data Brokers and the Sale of Data on U.S. Military Personnel, November 2023.
svg.text: What identifiable broker records were actually offered for
Observed range: US$0.12-US$0.32 per military-related record, Duke University, 2023
*Arithmetic illustrations at the same observed unit range, not separate market observations.
Bar lengths are illustrative within each quantity and are not a shared linear scale.
Source: Duke Sanford School, Data Brokers and the Sale of Data on U.S. Military Personnel (Nov. 2023).
